newsitem.title: USA: Independent Bank sets split, payout hike.
newsitem.headline: Independent Bank sets split, payout hike.

text.p: Independent Bank Corp said Wednesday it approved a three-for-two common stock split and a 12 percent increase in its quarterly dividend.
Adjusted for the three-for-two stock split, the company's new dividend rate will be $0.185 a share, compared to a pre-split rate of $0.26 a share.

The new shares resulting from the split and the higher dividend will be distributed on April 30 to shareholders of record on April 4. The cash dividend will be paid on the newly issued as well as the current outstanding shares of common stock.
Independent Bank, which operates 61 offices in Michigan, said it had assets totaling $889 million at December 31, 1996.
